summary: Regression test for performance optimizations (React.lazy route code-splitting + MongoDB indexes + Cache-Control on media + read-through caching of /api/site/*). NO regressions found. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass — public cached endpoints /api/site/homepage, /api/site/config, /api/site/promotions all return 200 and homepage responses are byte-identical on repeated calls (cache working). All 4 role logins (admin/customer/partner/merchant) succeed via /auth/send-otp + /auth/verify-otp with OTP 123456 and /auth/me returns the correct role. Admin /api/admin/dashboard, customer /api/bookings + /api/wallet return 200. Media upload POST /api/media/upload succeeds, returns a proxy URL (/api/media/s3/...), which is retrievable via GET and served as image/webp. Frontend: Playwright navigation across / (Landing, eager), /services (lazy), /membership (lazy) all resolve, the Suspense fallback data-testid='route-loading' disappears in every case, and all 4 protected panels /account /partner /merchant /admin load real content after OTP login (body text > 1300 chars, no lingering fallback, admin dashboard shows GMV/Bookings/Partners KPIs, customer shows bookings + wallet ₹250).

minor.issue: Backend correctly sets 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=2592000, immutable' (verified via curl to localhost:8001), but the preview ingress/CDN rewrites the response header to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. The perf win (30-day browser cache on media) will NOT reach real users on this preview domain — needs ingress config change or the header will only work in production. Test was made tolerant of this.

action_items: (Optional / infra) Preview ingress overrides Cache-Control to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' on /api/media/s3/* responses. Backend-set immutable header is stripped before reaching the browser. Confirm production ingress does not do the same — otherwise the 30-day media cache optimization is a no-op end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js code-split is clean: Landing eager, everything else lazy behind a single <Suspense fallback={<RouteFallback/>}> with data-testid='route-loading' — verified real chunks load for /services, /membership, /login, /account, /partner, /merchant, /admin without any blank screen or chunk-load error.

cache_service.cached wrappers on /api/site/homepage (45s), /api/site/config (120s), /api/site/promotions (60s) return identical payloads on back-to-back calls — cache is working. No stale-write issue observed in this run (admin settings save was not exercised in this regression pass; main agent should re-verify cache-bust after admin save if that path was refactored).
Media upload flow end-to-end works: POST /api/media/upload → 200 with proxy URL /api/media/s3/{key} → GET returns image/webp bytes. WebP method=4 change did not break encoding.
Backend logs are clean during the run (no tracebacks for the exercised paths).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Landing + 3 public lazy routes + 4 role logins all render real content, no route-loading fallback stuck)

seed_data_creation: None. One test media file uploaded to bucket key azpapp/test/*.webp (small 8x8 png); safe to leave.
